title: Predictions for Group Stage
openingLines: Round 3, final group stage, groups A,B,C and D
Now let us go game by game with the scorelines I would call.
disclaimer: Predictions are for entertainment purposes only.

matches.voiceover:
Switzerland and Canada both come into this match with 4 points, so this is a direct fight for first place in the group.
Both teams are in a comfortable position, and a draw could be enough to keep both of them in a strong qualification spot.
I expect a controlled game, with both sides avoiding unnecessary risks.
My prediction is 1-1 draw.

Bosnia comes into this match with only 1 point and needs a win to keep qualification hopes alive.
Qatar also has 1 point, but they have struggled defensively and have a much worse goal difference.
In a direct survival game, I see Bosnia having a little more quality to get the win.
My prediction is 2-1 Bosnia.

Morocco comes into this match with 4 points and only needs to confirm the job against the bottom team.
Haiti has lost both games, still has not scored, and has shown major problems going forward.
Morocco should control the match, stay organized, and win without too much trouble.
My prediction is 2-0 Morocco.

Scotland is still alive with 3 points, but now faces the strongest team in the group.
Brazil has 4 points, a better goal difference, and a strong chance to finish top of the group.
Scotland can compete, but Brazil has more talent to decide the game in key moments.
My prediction is 2-1 Brazil.

Czechia comes into this match with only 1 point and needs a win to have a real chance of qualifying.
Mexico has won both games, has not conceded yet, and looks almost qualified already.
Even if Mexico can manage the game, they have shown more consistency so far.
My prediction is 2-1 Mexico.

South Africa has 1 point, but their goal difference makes qualification very difficult.
South Korea has 3 points and knows that a win could put them very close to the next round.
This should be an open game because both teams need something, but South Korea looks better prepared to win it.
My prediction is 2-1 South Korea.

Ecuador has only 1 point and needs a very difficult win to stay alive.
Germany has won both games, scored 9 goals, and has been one of the most dominant teams in the tournament.
Even with possible rotation, Germany has enough attacking volume to control this match.
My prediction is 3-1 Germany.

Curaçao has 1 point, but they have already conceded 7 goals and have one of the worst goal differences in the group.
Ivory Coast has 3 points and can put itself in a very strong position with a win.
With more physical strength, better organization, and more urgency, Ivory Coast should control this game.
My prediction is 2-0 Ivory Coast.

Japan and Sweden are in a direct fight for qualification, making this one of the biggest games of the round.
Japan has 4 points and can play for the draw, while Sweden needs a result after losing in the second match.
Both attacks have already shown real quality, so I expect an open game with goals on both sides.
My prediction is 2-2 draw.

Tunisia has lost both games, conceded 9 goals, and has almost no margin for error left.
The Netherlands has 4 points, has scored 7 goals, and can confirm qualification with a win.
The technical gap and current attacking form point clearly toward the Netherlands.
My prediction is 3-0 Netherlands.

Türkiye has lost both opening games and still has not scored in the tournament.
The United States comes in with 6 points, 6 goals scored, and full control of the group.
Even if the United States manages the lead, they have more intensity and should win again.
My prediction is 2-0 United States.

Paraguay and Australia both come into this match with 3 points, so this could decide the second qualification spot.
Australia has the advantage on goal difference and can play in a more controlled way.
Paraguay needs to attack more, but that could also make the game tense and balanced.
My prediction is 1-1 draw.
